# EchoNet-Dynamic source subset

This directory retains the upstream EchoNet-Dynamic Python package used as the
segmentation baseline, along with its MIT license. The source repository,
commit, retrieval date, and archive SHA256 are recorded in
[`../echonet_source.json`](../echonet_source.json).

The original EchoNet-Dynamic image dataset is not included or redistributed.
For upstream documentation and dataset terms, see
<https://github.com/echonet/dynamic> and
<https://echonet.github.io/dynamic/>.
